quest.heading: THE BERG AWAITS
quest.subtitle: A secret expedition has been prepared...
intro: The Fox has prepared the expedition.
quest.question: Are you excited for the Drakensberg?

noDialogue.title: Interesting...
noDialogue.body: The Fox has detected suspicious Huntress behaviour.

noDialogue.title: Huntress...
noDialogue.body:
There will be mountains.
A river.
Pines.
Stars.

...and a Fox. 🦊

noDialogue.title: A formal notice
noDialogue.body: The mountains have filed a complaint.

noDialogue.title: Hmm.
noDialogue.body: The Fox is beginning to question your intentions.

noDialogue.title: This is becoming suspicious.
noDialogue.body: You know you're supposed to say yes, right?

dodgeMessages: The Fox has hidden the answer.
quest.acceptedBody: The Huntress has accepted the expedition.
quest.sunsetBody: The river is still talking. The escarpment is catching the last of the sun.
quest.nightLine: Some adventures are worth looking up for. ✨
quest.nightBody: Look up. The sky is not empty.

otterFound.title: OTTER DISCOVERED!
otterFound.body: The Huntress has found one of the rare creatures of the Berg.

constellation.title: A constellation has been discovered.
constellation.body: Even the sky knows about the Fox and Huntress.

quest.allFoundLine: You've got the eyes of a true Huntress.
quest.allFoundWaitLine: Wait until it's night for a surprise...
